verdict.rationale: Insomnia offers local Scratch Pad with no login (insomnia-docs-31), Git Sync keeping project data in user's own repo rather than Insomnia's servers (insomnia-docs-22, insomnia-docs-44), and a data-security note that sync servers cannot read sensitive project data (insomnia-docs-34). However, there is no explicit documentation of user-initiated data deletion controls, retention policy settings, or an account/data-deletion mechanism for cloud-stored data. missing for 10: explicit data retention settings/policy, a documented data deletion/export-and-purge workflow, and independent confirmation of these controls in practice.
